classification.difficultyReason: Sketch four straight lines, rearranging two equations to identify their gradients, then use inverse tangent and the inclination range.

content.prompt: Sketch these lines then find the angle of inclination to the nearest degree.

spec.description: Blank double-arrow Cartesian axes without ticks, grid, numerical scale or origin label.
spec.mathematics: Student chooses a scale and sketches y=3x+6.

answer.worked:
Plot $(-2,0)$ and $(0,6)$ and draw the straight line through them.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=3\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}(3)\\\theta&\approx72^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.mathematics: Student chooses a scale and sketches y=-x/2+1.

answer.worked:
Plot $(0,1)$ and $(2,0)$ and draw the straight line through them.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=-\frac12\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(-\frac12\right)\\\alpha&\approx-26.565^\circ\\\theta&=180^\circ+\alpha\\\theta&\approx153^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.mathematics: Student chooses a scale and sketches 3x+4y=-12.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}4y&=-3x-12\\y&=-\frac34x-3\\m&=-\frac34\end{aligned}$$
Plot $(-4,0)$ and $(0,-3)$ and draw the straight line through them.
$$\begin{aligned}\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(-\frac34\right)\\\alpha&\approx-36.870^\circ\\\theta&=180^\circ+\alpha\\\theta&\approx143^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.mathematics: Student chooses a scale and sketches x/3-y/2=1.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}2x-3y&=6\\-3y&=6-2x\\y&=\frac23x-2\\m&=\frac23\end{aligned}$$
Plot $(3,0)$ and $(0,-2)$ and draw the straight line through them.
$$\begin{aligned}\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac23\right)\\\theta&\approx34^\circ\end{aligned}$$
